description: This file defines the CommentsController class responsible for handling comment-related API endpoints such as creating, retrieving, and deleting comments within an ASP.NET Core application. It uses MediatR for command/query dispatching and enforces security via authorization schemes.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: Controller managing comment operations including create, get, and delete actions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment for an article specified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all comments for the specified article.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment by id from the article.
